reuse.reason: Business category, business consultation and membership/offer pages share collaborative assistance context; not VISTRAH staff.
The outdoor subcategory and outdoor structures service both represent fixed outdoor design. This asset is expressly not used for retractable or bioclimatic products.
Home, services index, contact and career consultation all represent an assistance conversation; not a listed provider or VISTRAH employee.
Cloud service and automated job-source administration share technical infrastructure context.
The real estate category uses its representative property-search subject; not a property listing.
The civil construction category uses its representative residential-construction subject.
Tax category, income-tax assistance and payment history share financial document context; not an official Indian tax form or real transaction.
The marketing category and consultation service both show campaign planning.
The technology category uses its representative website-development subject.
Local services category uses its representative interior-design subject.
Authentication, account planning, Finds/profile and navigation recovery states share the personal-planning desk motif; never a fallback for catalogue services.
DevOps service and workflow administration share technical operations context.
Market research and admin overview share illustrative reporting context; stock charts are not VISTRAH metrics.
Documentation service, catalogue/audit record management and order history share organized document context.
Business process support and customer/admin request management share administrative work context.
Professional consultation and provider administration share professional coordination context; not a provider portrait.
The Jobs category and public vacancy pages share workplace context; this is not a photograph of an advertised employer.
